tender_overview.title: CONVERSION OF HT O/H 11 KV OPEN LINE (55SQMM/100SQMM) TO MVCC OVERHEAD CONDUCTOR AND UNDER GROUND NETWORKING IN JURISDICTION OF MEHEMDABAD DIVISION UNDER MGVCL UNDER SI SCHEME ROBUST-III
tender_overview.contract_type: Full Turnkey Contract (Design, Supply and Installation)
tender_overview.bid_system: Single Stage Two-Envelope Bidding Process with e-Procurement

scope_of_work.details: Field survey for deciding location of poles, distribution transformers, proposed route of 33 KV, 11KV and LT lines, location of 33/11 KV sub-stations with transformer capacity and feeder details, locations of new distribution transformers. Preparation of feeder wise Bill of Quantity (BOQ) for each proposed work and submission to Engineer-in-charge for approval before commencement of actual work.

Supply, testing, packing, transportation and insurance of all materials and equipment from manufacturer's work to site including all raw materials such as steel, zinc for galvanizing, reinforcement steel, cement for foundation, coke for earthing, bolts, nuts & washers, danger plates, phase plates, number plates etc. All distribution transformers to meet Energy Efficiency Level-1 as per IS 1180 with BIS certification.

All architectural and civil designs including control room, foundation for equipment, transformers, isolators, VCB to be approved by Engineer-in-charge. Volume and quality of concreting for foundation of support, equipment foundation, gantry structure foundation, stay set etc. as per specifications. All steel structures (except STPs) to be hot dip galvanized as per Indian Standard.

Receipt, storage, insurance, preservation and conservation of equipment at site. Fabrication, pre-assembly (if any), erection, testing and putting into satisfactory operation of all equipment/materials. Within substation yard, all clamps and connectors for bus-bar to be crimped, and equipment connecting clamps to be bolted type.

Site testing, commissioning of all items & materials, pre-commissioning, guarantee tests and successful commissioning. Clearance for installation once materials are accepted by turnkey contractor and employer representative. Quality checks and inspections during execution as per Manufacturing Quality Plan (MQP) and Field Quality Plan (FQP).

Project manager assignment with authority to make commitments and decisions. Preparation and maintenance of project detailed Work Execution Plan, manpower deployment plan, progress monitoring and reporting. Providing engineering data and drawings for review, approval and records. Preparation of project completion report and handing over works to employer.

Implementation of Quality Assurance Mechanism (QAM) with pre-dispatch inspections, 100% verification of works/materials, vendor approval process, factory inspections, witnessing acceptance tests, field inspections during implementation, and Site Observation Reports (SOR) for remedial actions.

Collection of asset attributes (Data Model) from utility, GPS coordinates collection to defined accuracy level, physical marking procedure for surveyed assets and consumers, GIS asset information updating as mandatory requirement for completion certificate issuance, use of mobile App (GEO URJA) for proper GIS tagging of new assets.

Engraving of 'Developed under SI' on materials like poles, transformers, cables, energy meters. Installation of signboards for major infrastructure showing work details, commissioning date, estimated cost, and scheme information. Compliance with statutory laws, technical specifications, and tender drawings.

Provision of training, operations and maintenance manuals, as-built drawings. Warranty period services and activities as mentioned in contract. Material reconciliation, payment reconciliations, and formal contract closing procedures upon completion of defect liability/guarantee period.

technical.similar_works_definition: Experience in similar work erecting, testing and commissioning of (11 KV & above voltage class) cabling works either turnkey or partial turnkey in any under Public electrical utility of Central or State Govt. in India / Government Sector / Power Utility (Government or Private) / Power sector PSUs & Power Sector CPSUs / Any Private or Government power generating or transmitting company/private Developer

options.requirement: Experience in similar work under single contract, costing not less than Rs. 133.31 Crore (70% of estimated amount). The works should be completed works only.
Experience in similar works under two contracts, each costing not less than Rs. 76.18 Crore (40% of estimated amount). The works should be completed works only.
Experience in similar works under three contracts, each costing not less than Rs. 57.13 Crore (30% of estimated amount). The works should be completed works only.

financial.requirement: Must be positive for each of the last three Financial Years. Net worth means sum total of paid up capital and free reserves (excluding revaluation reserves) reduced by accumulated losses and intangible assets.
For best three years out of last five financial years should not be less than Rs. 5713.52 Lakhs (30% of estimated project cost).

Must have liquid assets and/or evidence of access to fund-based credit facilities of not less than Rs 1904.50 Lakhs (10% of estimated project cost). Banker should confirm credit facility is earmarked for the Works.

All JV partners shall meet net worth requirement individually. MAAT and liquid assets requirements to be met collectively by adding figures of all partners. Lead partner must meet at least 40% of MAAT and liquid assets criteria.

conditions: requires Contract Performance Securities for both parts

progressive_payments.milestone: As per Terms and Procedures of Payment appendix

firm_components: Fixed Price contracts - prices are fixed during performance and not subject to variation on any account
price_variation.composite_formula: Price adjustment during performance of contract to reflect changes in cost elements such as labor, material, transport and Contractor's equipment in accordance with procedures specified in Appendix 2 of Form 5

special_requirements: Volume and quality of concreting must meet specifications - non-compliance requires dismantling and redoing at contractor's cost
Extended Maintenance cover for Defect Liability Period required in insurance
Security must be valid till 180 days beyond Defect Liability Period
Minor Defects must be rectified within 30 days to avoid penalty
Third party inspection at NABL accredited lab mandatory for major materials
